description: Assemble a global profile for one QCL item in a single call: top-producing countries, the annual production trend, and trade flows (top exporters and importers). Supply item_code or item_query; code wins when both are supplied. A query selects a unique normalized exact label, otherwise a unique relevance match; ambiguous queries require an explicit code. Each ranking uses the selected item at each country's own latest year with data, grouped by unit. The trend is returned inline as year/value points. Country-level only (aggregates excluded). QCL is required; unavailable TCL yields a production-only profile with a notice. When the merged observation set is too large to inline, it spills to a DataCanvas table (canvas_id + table_name) — call faostat_dataframe_describe for its columns, then faostat_dataframe_query for deeper SQL.

canvas_id.description: Canvas ID to stage onto, as returned by a prior faostat_query_observations / faostat_commodity_profile call — exactly 10 characters of letters, digits, hyphens, and underscores. Omit to stage onto this session’s canvas, created on the first spill and reused by every later call, so tables staged earlier in the session sit alongside this one.

item_code.description: Exact item code present in QCL; takes precedence over item_query. Obtain it from faostat_resolve_codes with domain QCL and dimension item.

item_query.description: Commodity label or search term (e.g. "Wheat"). A unique normalized exact QCL label wins, otherwise the relevance search must match exactly one item. Broad queries such as "maize" or "milk" require item_code. Supply this or item_code.

top_n.description: Number of top producers / exporters / importers to return. Max 50.

year_end.description: Inclusive end year for the trend (e.g. 2022).

year_start.description: Inclusive start year for the trend (e.g. 1990).

name: faostat_commodity_profile

canvas_id.description: Canvas ID this call staged onto. When spilled it holds table_name — pass both to faostat_dataframe_describe (table_name as name) for the columns and types, then canvas_id to faostat_dataframe_query for SQL. Also present when the merged set fit inline and no table was staged; faostat_dataframe_describe with this canvas_id then lists any tables already staged on it. Absent when the canvas is disabled or staging failed.

error.description: Present when the call failed. Absent on success.

code.description: JSON-RPC error code for this failure.

reason.description: Machine-readable failure mode. Declared by this tool: `missing_item`: Neither item_code nor item_query was supplied. `ambiguous_item`: The query matches more than one QCL item without a unique exact label. `no_match`: The query matched no item, or item_code is absent from QCL. `domain_not_indexed`: The production domain (QCL) is not in the local mirror selection (FAOSTAT_DOMAINS), so there is no production data to profile. `index_not_ready`: The production domain (QCL) is selected, but its mirror is cold — its initial sync has never completed. `invalid_year_range`: year_start is greater than year_end — a self-contradictory range that can never match. The bounds reach the production, trade, and merged canvas-stream queries alike, so every one of them would return nothing. `canvas_not_found`: DataCanvas is enabled and canvas_id does not resolve to a live canvas — unknown, expired, or owned by another tenant. `query_timeout`: The profile's mirror reads (commodity resolution, rankings, trend, staging stream) — time queued behind other calls plus execution — ran past the 45-second per-call ceiling. Other values are possible when a failure originates below the handler.

recovery.description: Actionable next step for the caller.

message.description: Human-readable description of what went wrong.

item_query.description: Supplied query echoed back, or the canonical selected label for code-only calls.

itemsTruncated.description: Always false: successful profiles select one item without truncating selection.

notice.description: States where the observation set went — the canvas table, inline result, staging failure, or disabled canvas — plus unavailable trade data, mixed units, or other partial-result context.

production_trend.description: The annual production series for the selected item, summed over countries per year and ordered oldest-first. Aggregated in SQL over the complete filtered match, so it is not affected by the canvas staging cap.

flags.description: Distinct data-quality flags across the summed observations, comma-separated and sorted — commonly A=Official, B=time-series break, E=Estimated, I=Imputed, M=Missing (value cannot exist), T=Unofficial, X=from an international organization, plus others FAOSTAT defines per domain; treat any unrecognized flag as informational, never assume official. Null when no summed observation carried a flag. More than one flag means the total mixes data qualities.

observations.description: Observations summed into value — read it alongside value, since a change in coverage moves the total independently of production.

unit.description: Unit of measure for value; null when unspecified. Points are grouped by unit, so a year can appear once per unit rather than summing incomparable quantities.

value.description: Selected item production summed across every country reporting that year.

resolvedItemCodes.description: Item codes the commodity query resolved to.

resolvedItemMatches.description: Number of selected QCL items; always one for a successful profile.

resolved_items.description: The single selected QCL item and its canonical label.

spilled.description: True when the merged observation set was staged on a canvas table.

staged_row_count.description: Rows actually staged on the merged canvas table (present when spilled). Equals the 50,000-row cap when truncated.

table_name.description: Canvas table holding the staged observations — production plus trade when the trade domain (TCL) is indexed, production only when it is not (present when spilled). The notice names which of the two the table holds. Pass it as name to faostat_dataframe_describe for its columns (a domain column tags each row QCL or TCL), then reference it in faostat_dataframe_query SQL.

top_exporters.description: Top exporters by summed export quantity (empty when trade is not indexed).

flags.description: Distinct data-quality flags across the summed observations, comma-separated and sorted — commonly A=Official, B=time-series break, E=Estimated, I=Imputed, M=Missing (value cannot exist), T=Unofficial, X=from an international organization, plus others FAOSTAT defines per domain; treat any unrecognized flag as informational, never assume official. Null when no summed observation carried a flag. More than one flag means the total mixes data qualities.

observations.description: Observations summed into value for the selected item and reporting year.

unit.description: Unit of measure for value; null when unspecified. Rows are grouped by unit, so values in different units are never summed together — a country can appear once per unit.

value.description: Export quantity for the selected item and country in its latest reporting year.

year.description: This country's own latest year with data, computed per country — a country whose series ends earlier still ranks, at its own last reported year.

top_importers.description: Top importers by summed import quantity (empty when trade is not indexed).

flags.description: Distinct data-quality flags across the summed observations, comma-separated and sorted — commonly A=Official, B=time-series break, E=Estimated, I=Imputed, M=Missing (value cannot exist), T=Unofficial, X=from an international organization, plus others FAOSTAT defines per domain; treat any unrecognized flag as informational, never assume official. Null when no summed observation carried a flag. More than one flag means the total mixes data qualities.

observations.description: Observations summed into value for the selected item and reporting year.

unit.description: Unit of measure for value; null when unspecified. Rows are grouped by unit, so values in different units are never summed together — a country can appear once per unit.

value.description: Import quantity for the selected item and country in its latest reporting year.

year.description: This country's own latest year with data, computed per country — a country whose series ends earlier still ranks, at its own last reported year.

top_producers.description: Top producers by summed production (countries only).

flags.description: Distinct data-quality flags across the summed observations, comma-separated and sorted — commonly A=Official, B=time-series break, E=Estimated, I=Imputed, M=Missing (value cannot exist), T=Unofficial, X=from an international organization, plus others FAOSTAT defines per domain; treat any unrecognized flag as informational, never assume official. Null when no summed observation carried a flag. More than one flag means the total mixes data qualities.

observations.description: Observations summed into value for the selected item and reporting year.

unit.description: Unit of measure for value; null when unspecified. Rows are grouped by unit, so values in different units are never summed together — a country can appear once per unit.

value.description: Production for the selected item and country in its latest reporting year.

year.description: This country's own latest year with data, computed per country — a country whose series ends earlier still ranks, at its own last reported year.

trend_points.description: Total production observations aggregated into production_trend. Exact — the aggregation runs over the complete filtered match, not a capped page.

truncated.description: True when the STAGED CANVAS TABLE hit the 50,000-row staging cap and is therefore a PREFIX of the merged observation set — re-query faostat_query_observations partitioned by year to stage the rest. The rankings and production_trend above are SQL aggregates over the complete match and stay exact either way.
